versions.subject: rule: dropbox api use
versions.detection:
selection:
   Initiated: 'true'
   DestinationHostname|endswith: 
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
filter:
   Image|contains: '\Dropbox'
condition: selection
